title: Chapter 851
paragraphs: Chapter 851
Episode 211. Negotiation with Orgal (5)
"A successor, you say?"
[Let's go inside for now.]
After re-entering the conference room, Orgal took a moment to catch his breath. It seemed that he had no intention of hiding his defeat and injuries from Jin and Murakan.
[Zito has always wanted me to follow in his footsteps.]
"From what I heard from Ameris, Zito is someone who rules the world through violence and pain."

[Yes, he did unite the underworld in such a way in the ancient times. The Zito I experienced during those times... it was a hell that has never been shown in Insen. There have been many tyrants and murderers in the world above, but they're cute compared to when he unified the underworld.]
"Why would such a madman want you as a successor? Your Kinzelo's talk of purification is not normal either, but it seems like you have a different approach?"
[I can't tell that either. He has always been oddly kind to me, even though I've never agreed with his beliefs. He might have seen something in me, or there might be no reason at all.]
There might be no reason at all.
Orgal truly thought so. As far as he knew, Zito was enough of a character to be so.
"Do you have any idea why Zito woke up?"

[There could be several reasons. Some forces in the underworld have been constantly trying to wake Zito. Even five hundred years ago during the Holy Kingdom Defense War, they made a deal with a witch to recover Zito's eye. Ultimately, they must have succeeded. Lokia Ganesto might be involved.]

-[Before killing me, Lokia said her goal was the resurrection of the sun god. The reason she killed all her companions and only spared Bale. She intended to completely obliterate the current world and restore a just world. She referred to it as the original form of the world. Lokia used everything for that purpose. The family, the witch, and even Zefil.]
-[Even the birth of the malignant god this time, there's a high possibility that Lokia was involved.]
Jin suddenly remembered what Padler said just before his demise.
'The demon Zito and the malignant god have something in common. If Lokia truly wants to obliterate and rebuild the world, Zito is one of the most suitable pawns.'
Even if Lokia did not have a direct influence on the resurrection of Zito, in the end, Zito's acts of violence and pain would have aided in achieving her goal.
[And now... we can't even describe it as some forces. Even the demons, who were like the leaders of the anti-Zito forces, are following him.]
"Oh, you were defeated by that demon?"
When Murakan sneered, Orgal shrugged his shoulders.

[It was a character named Phaelito Belgasium. He's known as the Sword Demon in the demon world, and his sword, Bascal, has the ability to block authority. I got hit without being able to use my power properly.]
"So you're saying a demon like you became a mess just because you lost some power? Ah, are you weaker than I thought?"
[Think what you like.]
"You haven't found any news about Lokia yet, have you?"
[The most essential person in finding Lokia has not yet arrived. We should talk again after he starts his work.]
'He' referred to the Lord of Bachmaga in the Third Demon World of the middle world. As soon as Orgal recovered his memory about Lokia, he had ordered Shagal Bachma to summon him.
"But, it's a bit strange that this demon king Zito wants a successor."
[What is?]

"If he is perfectly well, there's no reason to find a successor in advance, is there? Of course, he could be a divine being who can kill you at any time, but it's strange that he kept the sparks alive while he's just in the stage of regaining his power."
That was something Orgal hadn't considered at all.
[That's... a good point.]

"Besides, there's a strange point even under the assumption that Lokia was involved in Zito's resurrection. Lokia's goal is the resurrection of the sun god, which is completely different from what Zito pursues. But if she resurrected Zito, doesn't that mean that Lokia has a means to control Zito? After the world is destroyed as much as needed, she has to discard Zito. The same assumption can be applied to the past malignant god."
[That's true as well. Damn it, I don't know what kind of world that bug is trying to get through the resurrection of the sun god.]

Anything would have been far from the ideals of Kinzelo. Sanna's Sun God religion, Kinzelo, the red people, Lokia. They all wanted the resurrection of the sun god, but the results they wanted to achieve through it were all different.
[I also don't know what the basis is for believing she can control Zito. For now, it's all just speculation.]
"Do you have any idea about the approximate time when one side of the Magic Sealing Wall completely collapses and the demons from underground come up?"
[It wouldn't be strange if the demons come up to the surface in a few days.]
"That much?"

[When I went down to negotiate, honestly, I didn't consider the case of my defeat at all. Even if the top demon in the underworld came out, I was sure that it would take a lot of energy to get over the cracks in the Magic Sealing Wall and come up to the middle world. But Phaelito didn't seem to get very tired even after crossing the crack.]
That meant the crack in the Magic Sealing Wall was much larger than Orgal had anticipated.

[If he had been tired, even considering Bascal, I wouldn't have been beaten so embarrassingly. Of course, saying it could happen within a few days is considering the worst-case scenario. The exact time is unknown. We just have to hope that the surface can prepare one more day.]
"Even now, what about repairing the Magic Sealing Wall?"
[It's impossible. Even with the authority the great serpent now possesses, it's hard to prevent the crack in the Magic Sealing Wall from getting bigger.]
Ameris didn't even know that a crack had appeared in part of the Magic Sealing Wall.
"Isn't it good to try at least once?"

[It's risky. If I go back and tell the great serpent, I'm sure he will have a similar reaction. If the crack in the Magic Sealing Wall shows a tendency to recover as it gets closer to the great serpent, and if the serpent's power is insufficient, it may rather cause side effects.]
Just as Orgal said, it was only a matter of time before the demons of the true demon world came to the surface.

[There are not many things we can hope for, Jin Runcandel. The first is that the Magic Sealing Wall holds out much longer than we expect. The second is, as you said, there is a reason why Zito is obsessed with a successor. For example, because he is going to disappear soon.]
"The third is, even if the underground forces awaken fully, the surface can handle it."
[...Yes. For instance, Zito is likely to become a common enemy like the malignant god. However, the situation is not suitable for forming a temporary alliance like then.]
Zipfel is already at war with the red people, and unlike during the malignant god's time, the power of the underground forces hasn't even fully revealed itself yet.
There's no reason to hastily form a temporary alliance. Jin didn't want to join hands with the enemies that he would eventually have to eliminate.
More than anything, now that he had confirmed the truth of a thousand years ago.

Zipfel and Runcandel were destined to never coexist under one sky. Even disregarding the Red Devil War, Murakan would never tolerate an alliance with Zipfel. Jin, the head of the family, was no different.
But as much as they are 'common enemies', unless Zipfel joins hands with the underground, they are naturally bound to fight with them.
From the perspective of the Vamel Union, the best situation was where Zipfel's major forces, including Elona Zipfel, and the underground forces annihilate each other.

"I have no such intention. There is only one case where the three forces will form a temporary alliance again. When Zito brings a greater danger than during the time of the malignant god and we have no choice but to choose between the end of the world and alliance."
[I think so too. However, Jin Runcandel. We, Kinzelo, want to make a promise with you.]
"A promise?"
[Even if we don't form a temporary alliance, we won't hesitate to provide all kinds of support when the Vamel Union needs to fight the underground.]
"Without any return?"
[Yes. Whether it's information about the underground, or military force. We'll support whatever is needed.]
"Are you trying to pick a fight without getting involved?"
[Aren't you also waiting for us to find Lokia with that mindset, Pichailbane. It's about using each other when we need to.]
Jin shrugged his shoulders and nodded his head.
"Well, there's no reason to refuse if you're offering help for free. Personally, I'm quite accustomed to getting things for free from Kinzelo."
[... Hearing that makes me want to take back what I just said.]
"My great-grandfather used to say, 'The bigger the fight, the better. I look forward to Kinzelo's endless support without any return. And also information about Lokia Ganesto."
Although cunning, it was fortunate for Orgal that Jin had decided to 'accept' the support. Even if not an alliance, coordination was clearly necessary.
"I should go now. Take care of yourself, Orgal."
The Tower of Tales.
While having tea with Elona, Veradin suddenly saw her startle.
"Why do you react so? Miss Elona."
"...Something, something powerful has awakened."
"Something powerful has awakened...? Surely not, the Red People?"
"I thought the power that woke up from the underground would be the Red People, but no. It's completely different from the energy we usually feel from them. It's similar to a demon."
"A demon... Wait, you said, 'from underground'. Are you saying the energy you felt is not just one?"
Elona pointed her finger far out the window.
"I feel an indescribably huge power from over there too. And this power is, definitely human... "
Veradin stared at where her finger pointed. He saw the open Teia Plains.
And suddenly, Veradin thought of a certain area reached by crossing the Teia Plains and several kingdoms and unprotected zones. He also remembered the figure of a human known to be there.
"...The Black Sea?"
At his words, Elona slowly nodded. The power she felt was definitely being transmitted from a human in the Black Sea.
